deselect.reason: fails on Python 3.13 and later, with or without the tracer: there, an autospecced async method (pytest-mock's spy) is a coroutine function that records the call only when it runs; the package schedules set_in_cache with asyncio.create_task, and the test asserts the call before the task runs (the test patches ensure_future, which the package no longer calls). aiocache 0.12.3's CI ran Python 3.7 to 3.11
